verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Park Lane in the heart of Mayfair, near Hyde Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on Park Lane in the heart of Mayfair, our distinguished 5-star luxury hotel in central London is conveniently located near Hyde Park.

verified_facts.text: Grosvenor House sits directly across Park Lane from Hyde Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grosvenor House is located directly across Park Lane from one of London’s most celebrated havens

verified_facts.text: The former home of the Dukes of Westminster and Gloucester was designed and rebuilt as a hotel in 1929 by architects L. Rome Guthrie and Sir Edwin Lutyens.
verified_facts.excerpt: The former home of the Dukes of Westminster and Gloucester was originally designed and rebuilt as a hotel in 1929 by famed architects L. Rome Guthrie and Sir Edwin Lutyens

verified_facts.text: The Great Room is one of Europe's largest hotel ballrooms, seating up to 2000 guests for dinner.

verified_facts.text: The Great Room was once an ice rink where the late Queen Elizabeth II and her sister Margaret learnt to skate as children.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Great Room was once an ice rink where late Queen Elizabeth II and her sister Margaret learnt to skate as children.

verified_facts.text: Rooms take cues from autumn and spring in Hyde Park, while suites use a palette of warm neutrals.

verified_facts.text: Suites have pillowtop beds, marble bathrooms and views of Hyde Park, and some have private balconies.

verified_facts.text: Park View Suites have a king-size bedroom and a separate living room overlooking Hyde Park and Park Lane.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy waking up in a comfortable king-size bedroom with separate living room overlooking scenic views of Hyde Park and iconic Park Lane

verified_facts.text: JW Steakhouse serves prime USDA beef and takes inspiration from New York.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hearty prime USDA beef, classic steakhouse dishes and a legendary, iconic cheesecake. Taking inspiration from New York, the birthplace of the American steakhouse

verified_facts.text: The Les Clefs D'or concierge team can arrange experiences such as guided wellbeing walks in Mayfair and horseback riding in Hyde Park.
